page.overview:
What is Free City of Bervenia?

The Bervenia Free City is a location from Final Fantasy Tactics. Famous for being Saint Ajora Glabados's birthplace, this town is under the direct control of the Church of Glabados. It is located on the road between the Royal City of Lesalia and Zeltennia Castle.

Meliadoul Tengille chooses to set her ambush for Ramza Beoulve here. The ambush fails, and Meliadoul later defects to Ramza's cause after seeing Marquis Elmdore transform into Zalera.
